name: Create Project
description: Create a new project in a workspace or team. [See the documentation](https://developers.asana.com/docs/create-a-project)

configurable_props.name: team
configurable_props.label: Team
configurable_props.description: The team that this project is shared with. If the workspace for your project is an organization, you must supply a team to share the project with

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the project. This is generally a short sentence fragment that fits on a line in the UI for maximum readability. However, it can be longer.

configurable_props.name: notes
configurable_props.label: Notes
configurable_props.description: Free-form textual information associated with the project (ie., its description).

configurable_props.name: color
configurable_props.label: Color
configurable_props.description: The color associated with the status update

configurable_props.name: title
configurable_props.label: Title
configurable_props.description: The title of the project status update.

configurable_props.name: defaultView
configurable_props.label: Default View
configurable_props.description: The default view (list, board, calendar, or timeline) of a project

configurable_props.name: privacySetting
configurable_props.label: Privacy Setting
configurable_props.description: The privacy setting of the project. Note: Administrators in your organization may restrict the values of `privacy_setting`.

configurable_props.name: archived
configurable_props.label: Archived
configurable_props.description: Archived projects do not show in the UI by default and may be treated differently for queries

configurable_props.name: dueOn
configurable_props.label: Due On
configurable_props.description: The day on which this project is due. This takes a date with format YYYY-MM-DD.

configurable_props.name: startOn
configurable_props.label: Start On
configurable_props.description: The day on which work for this project begins. This takes a date with format YYYY-MM-DD. `Due On` must be present in the request when setting or unsetting the `Start On` parameter. Additionally, `Start On` and `Due On` cannot be the same date.

configurable_props.name: followers
configurable_props.label: Followers
configurable_props.description: Comma separated string of users. Followers are a subset of members who have opted in to receive "tasks added" notifications for a project.

configurable_props.name: htmlNotes
configurable_props.label: HTML Notes
configurable_props.description: The notes of the project with formatting as HTML

configurable_props.name: owner
configurable_props.label: Owner
configurable_props.description: The current owner of the project

configurable_props.name: defaultAccessLevel
configurable_props.label: Default Access Level
configurable_props.description: The default access for users or teams who join or are added as members to the project

configurable_props.name: minimumAccessLevelForCustomization
configurable_props.label: Minimum Access Level for Customization
configurable_props.description: The minimum access level needed for project members to modify this project's workflow and appearance

configurable_props.name: minimumAccessLevelForSharing
configurable_props.label: Minimum Access Level for Sharing
configurable_props.description: The minimum access level needed for project members to share the project with others
